reading.zh: 沿一次审批动线从左到右读：待办工作台看到任务 → 发起并填写表单 → 详情浮层完成审批；下一组是移动端 H5 与扫码 / 短链入口，二者与桌面共用同一套设计令牌。
reading.en: Follow one approval journey left to right: see the task on the workbench, initiate and fill the form, then approve in the detail overlay; the next group is mobile H5 with its QR and short-link entry, sharing one token set with the desktop.
